guardrails: Reject ANY nonprivileged allow WRITE/ADD/DELETE/WRITE_DAC/WRITE_OWNER ACE, including inherited
No OS ACL mutation or elevation
Check parent before child creation and child after creation

owner_windows_readonly_probe.runtime: native .NET 10.0.403 from owner user token, no root or host mutations
